title: Can, could, be able to and be allowed to
summary: Способность и разрешение: чем **could** отличается от **was able to / managed to**, как образуются будущее и перфект от can, **could have + V3**, **can't help** и разница между **can, could, may, be allowed to**.
ru:
## Способность в настоящем и других временах
У **can** нет инфинитива, причастия и будущего времени, поэтому во всех «недостающих» формах нужен заменитель **be able to**:
> I **will be able to** start on Monday. — Я смогу начать в понедельник. (~~I will can~~)
> She **has been able to** walk since the operation. — Она может ходить с момента операции. (~~has could~~)
> You **might be able to** get a refund. — Возможно, вам вернут деньги. (после другого модального глагола)
В настоящем **can** естественнее и короче; **am able to** звучит формально или подчёркивает достижение.

## Could или was able to: общая способность и конкретный случай
Главное правило для прошлого. **Could** — **общая способность** («умел вообще»); **was able to / managed to** — **успешное действие в конкретной ситуации**:
> She **could** swim when she was four. — Она умела плавать в четыре года. (общая способность)
> The firefighters **were able to** rescue everyone. — Пожарным удалось спасти всех. (конкретный случай)
> After three attempts she **managed to** open the safe. — С третьей попытки ей удалось открыть сейф.
В **отрицании** различия нет: **couldn't** и **wasn't able to** подходят в обоих случаях: I **couldn't** open the door. Исключение из главного правила — **could** с глаголами восприятия и мышления (see, hear, understand, remember): с ними **could** возможно и в утверждении о конкретной ситуации: I **could see** smoke.

## Could have + V3 и couldn't have
> I **could have** taken the job, but I preferred to stay. — Я мог бы взять эту работу, но предпочёл остаться. (возможность не реализована)
> He **couldn't have** known. — Он не мог знать. (это невозможно)

## Разрешение: can, could, may и be allowed to
- **Can** — неформально, **could** — вежливо, **may** — формально: **Could** I use your phone? / **May** I come in?
- Общее разрешение в прошлом: We **could** wear what we liked on Fridays.
- Конкретное разрешение в прошлом — **was allowed to**: Yesterday we **were allowed to** leave early. (не could)
- **be allowed to / be permitted to** — для правил и других форм: Visitors **are not allowed to** take photos.

## Возможность и вывод
- **Can** — общая возможность: Prices **can** vary a lot. — Цены могут сильно различаться.
- **Could** — конкретная возможность: It **could** rain later. / You **could** try the new café. (предложение)
- **Can't be** — уверенность в невозможности: That **can't be** Tom — he's in Paris.
- **can't help + -ing:** I **can't help** laughing. — Не могу не смеяться.

## Типичные ошибки
- ~~I could pass the exam yesterday.~~ → I **was able to** / **managed to** pass the exam yesterday.
- ~~I will can come.~~ → I **will be able to** come.
- ~~We could leave early yesterday~~ (разовое разрешение) → We **were allowed to** leave early yesterday.
- ~~She can to swim.~~ → She **can swim**.
en:
## Ability in the present and in other tenses
**Can** has no infinitive, participle or future, so **be able to** replaces it in the missing forms:
> I **will be able to** start on Monday. (~~I will can~~)
> She **has been able to** walk since the operation.
> You **might be able to** get a refund.
In the present **can** is shorter and more natural; **am able to** sounds formal or stresses achievement.

## Could or was able to: general ability or one occasion
**Could** is for **general ability**; **was able to / managed to** is for **success on one occasion**:
> She **could** swim when she was four. (general)
> The firefighters **were able to** rescue everyone. (one occasion)
> After three attempts she **managed to** open the safe.
In the **negative** there is no difference: **couldn't** and **wasn't able to** both work. But in the positive, **could** is fine for one occasion with verbs of perception and thinking (see, hear, understand, remember): I **could see** smoke.

## Could have + past participle and couldn't have
> I **could have** taken the job, but I preferred to stay. (the chance was not used)
> He **couldn't have** known. (it was impossible)

## Permission: can, could, may, be allowed to
- **Can** is informal, **could** is polite, **may** is formal.
- General past permission: We **could** wear what we liked on Fridays.
- Permission on one occasion in the past: Yesterday we **were allowed to** leave early. (not could)
- **be allowed to / be permitted to** for rules and other forms: Visitors **are not allowed to** take photos.

## Possibility and deduction
- **Can** — general possibility: Prices **can** vary a lot.
- **Could** — specific possibility or suggestion: It **could** rain later. / You **could** try the new café.
- **Can't be** — sure it is impossible: That **can't be** Tom — he's in Paris.
- **can't help + -ing:** I **can't help** laughing.

## Common mistakes
- ~~I could pass the exam yesterday.~~ → I **was able to** / **managed to** pass the exam yesterday.
- ~~I will can come.~~ → I **will be able to** come.
- ~~She can to swim.~~ → She **can swim**.
structure:
## Формулы
| Время/форма | Способность | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| настоящее | can / am able to | I **can** drive. |
| прошлое, общая способность | could / was able to | She **could** read at four. |
| прошлое, конкретный случай | was able to / managed to | He **was able to** escape. |
| будущее | will be able to | We **will be able to** help. |
| present perfect | have been able to | I **haven't been able to** sleep. |
| после модального | modal + be able to | You **might be able to** go. |
| нереализованная возможность | could have + V3 | I **could have** won. |

## Разрешение и возможность
| Форма | Значение | Пример |
|---|---|---|
| can / could / may | просьба о разрешении | **Could** I leave early? |
| be allowed to | правило, одноразовое разрешение | We **were allowed to** leave. |
| can | общая возможность | Dogs **can** be dangerous. |
| could | конкретная возможность / совет | It **could** snow tonight. |
| can't be | невозможно (вывод) | She **can't be** at home. |

## Отрицание и вопрос
> She **can't** / **couldn't** / **isn't able to** / **wasn't able to** swim.
> **Can** I ...? / **Could** you ...? / **Were** you **able to** ...?
> **Weren't** they **allowed to** park there?

exercises.title: Could, was able to, be able to
exercises.instruction: Вставьте нужную форму (can, could, be able to, be allowed to, managed to). Допустимые варианты засчитываются.

items.text: After three attempts, she finally {{was able to|managed to}} open the safe.
When I was five, I {{could|was able to}} already read.
If the repairs go to plan, we {{will be able to|'ll be able to}} move in by June.
I've never {{been able to}} whistle, however hard I try.
Visitors {{are allowed to|are permitted to|can|may}} take photos, but not use flash.
Yesterday we {{were allowed to|were permitted to}} leave early because of the storm.
You might {{be able to}} get a refund if you keep the receipt.

exercises.title: Подберите форму
exercises.instruction: Вставьте подходящее слово или форму. Допустимые варианты засчитываются.

items.text: She {{could have|could've|might have|might've}} won the race, but she stopped to help a fallen runner.
I {{couldn't|could not}} have left earlier; the boss kept me in a meeting all afternoon.
When I was at school, we {{could|were allowed to|were permitted to}} wear whatever we liked on Fridays.
I can't {{help}} laughing when I hear that story.
Prices {{can|may|could}} vary a great deal from shop to shop.
She isn't answering. She {{could|might|may}} be in a meeting.
I'm afraid I {{can't|cannot}} stand being stuck in traffic.

items.q: After a long search, the firefighters ___ rescue everyone from the building.
items.why: Конкретный успешный случай в прошлом → **were able to** (could в утверждении о конкретном случае не используется).

items.q: He ___ swim when he was only three.
I'm sorry, I ___ come to the party tomorrow.
items.why: Будущее от can → **will be able to**.

items.q: I haven't ___ sleep properly for weeks.
Yesterday the pupils ___ go home early.
items.why: Разовое разрешение в прошлом → **were allowed to**.

items.q: Look! I ___ see the mountains from my window.
items.why: С глаголами восприятия в настоящем естественно **can**; после can частица **to** не ставится.

items.q: She ___ passed the exam if she had studied harder.
items.why: Нереализованная возможность в прошлом → **could have + V3**.

options: I will can help you tomorrow.
I will be able to help you tomorrow.
items.why: У can нет формы будущего: **will be able to**.

options: Он не мог знать (это было невозможно).
items.why: **couldn't have + V3** — вывод о невозможности в прошлом.

items.q: Какое предложение говорит об успешном конкретном действии?
options: I managed to finish the report.

items.q: 'You could try the new café' — это:

options: Could you possibly lend me your pen?
Can you lend me your pen?

exercises.title: Перепишите
exercises.instruction: Перепишите предложение, используя слово или конструкцию в скобках.

items.prompt: She succeeded in persuading the manager. (managed) → She ...
answers: She managed to persuade the manager.

items.prompt: Next year it will be possible for us to travel abroad. (able) → Next year we ...
answers: Next year we will be able to travel abroad.
Next year we'll be able to travel abroad.

items.prompt: Pupils had permission to use phones during the trip. (allowed) → Pupils ...
answers: Pupils were allowed to use phones during the trip.
Pupils were allowed to use their phones during the trip.

items.prompt: It was possible for him to win, but he didn't. (could have) → He ...
answers: He could have won.
He could have won, but he didn't.
He could've won.
He could've won, but he didn't.
He could have won but he didn't.
He could've won but he didn't.

items.prompt: I'm certain it isn't her; she is in Paris. (can't) → It ...
answers: It can't be her.
It can't be her; she is in Paris.
It can't be her, she is in Paris.
It can't be her; she's in Paris.
It can't be her, she's in Paris.
It cannot be her.
It can't be her because she is in Paris.
It can't be her because she's in Paris.
It cannot be her; she is in Paris.
It cannot be her, she is in Paris.
It cannot be her because she is in Paris.

items.prompt: Perhaps the flight will be delayed. (could) → The flight ...
answers: The flight could be delayed.
The flight could get delayed.

items.prompt: What could you do well as a child that you can't do now?
items.sample: I could do the splits as a child, but I can't any more.

items.prompt: Describe something difficult that you managed to do recently.
items.sample: I managed to fix my bike myself last weekend.

items.prompt: What will you be able to do next year that you can't do now?
items.sample: I will be able to speak English fluently next year.

items.prompt: What were you allowed or not allowed to do at school?
items.sample: We weren't allowed to use phones during lessons.

items.prompt: Write something you could have done differently but didn't.
items.sample: I could have taken the earlier train, but I overslept.

items.prompt: Write about something you weren't able to do recently and explain why.
items.sample: I wasn't able to attend the meeting because my train was cancelled.
